items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Then we had Thigpen and Ward Pinkett. Nelson Harding on trombone. Sid Catlett on drums.

ctx.x: Then we had Thigpen and Ward Pinkett. Nelson Harding on trombone. Sid Catlett on drums. Ahmed(?) Canty on guitar. And then on bass we had Earl McGee, who came from the Louisiana Stompers. And Rex, of course. And Sonny White...
Oh, he sang. He sang with Luis Russell later on.
